title: IVG Smart Max Cola Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Cola Ice blends the familiar taste of classic Cola with a streak of cooling Menthol. The result is a bright and refreshing flavour that captures the sweetness of soft drink-style Cola with a chilled edge that keeps the flavour fresh and balanced. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir that attaches securely to the pod. Once assembled, the refill chamber feeds the pod automatically to support extended vaping — up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on your usage. No need to refill or replace coils. With mesh coil technology and smooth nicotine delivery, this pod offers a satisfying MTL experience with lasting flavour performance. Compatible only with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
